gao-gaoreports-gao-07-162g: Government Auditing Standards, in its January 2007 revision, is GAO's own rulebook for audits of government work. The revision is numbered GAO-07-162G and dated January 31, 2007. It supersedes the 2003 revision. The hosted text carries the front matter and the full table of contents rather than every chapter in full. The contents map standards on ethics, independence, competence, and quality control. They also map field work and reporting standards for financial audits, attestation work, and performance audits.
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-82g: GAO's draft playbook for auditing federal books — Volume Two of its Financial Audit Manual, put out for comment in late 2007. The draft spells out the methods and steps its audit teams follow when they grade an agency's money reports. The manual is the machinery behind the watchdog's bite, written down for all to see.
